rationale: The `process_entity` function must decode the bytes `entity_id` to UTF-8 string for output consistency with v1. The relay logic was hardcoded to use v1, so it is updated to use v2 for consistency with the schema change. The standalone sample construction requires explicit UTF-8 encoding of the string literal to match the new `bytes` type in v2.
assumptions: The protobuf generated bindings handle implicit UTF-8 conversion when constructing Entity with a bytes entity_id for v2.
No other runtime-specific encoding/decoding is required beyond the explicit decode/encode in this file.
